_note: Illustrative root causes for UI review only - not produced by the agent and not a finding about any real portfolio. Replace by writing the agent output to public/data/root_causes.json.

critical_kpis.kpi_performance_summary: End-to-End Cycle Time is 15.2 days against a 12-day target, making it 26.7% worse than target and Critical.
critical_kpis.why_not_performing: The evidence indicates cycle-time deterioration is concentrated in approval-layer waiting and in information dependencies on the RM, which together add several days of non-working time to a large share of disbursed cases before any additional processing effort is considered.

top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Cases wait between sequential approval layers rather than being processed, with approval steps accounting for the largest single block of waiting time in the process.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: Adds roughly 3.1 days of waiting to the average disbursed case and breaches the Monitoring & Approval stage SLA in a substantial share of cases.

top_root_causes.root_cause: Fragmented RM and customer information exchange
top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Incomplete submissions trigger repeated information requests handled over email, so the case idles while the analyst waits for the RM to respond.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: Affects roughly a third of cases and contributes multiple days of waiting per affected case.

top_root_causes.root_cause: Credit review queueing before analysis starts
top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Cases sit in the Credit Review queue before an analyst picks them up, with the delay concentrated in allocation rather than in the analysis itself.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: Adds around 1.6 days before analysis begins, and the Credit Review stage is the largest contributor to elapsed cycle time.

top_root_causes.root_cause: Legal review dependency on high-value cases
top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Cases routed to Legal wait for contract review with no service-level commitment on the return, extending the tail of the distribution.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: Concentrated in a minority of cases but adds material waiting where it applies.

top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: The same case data is captured more than once across the systems used in the process, adding processing effort at each handoff.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: Adds measurable processing hours per case and increases the number of systems each case touches.

critical_kpis.kpi_performance_summary: Rework Rate is 34.8% against a 10% target, nearly three and a half times the target level, and Critical.
critical_kpis.why_not_performing: The evidence shows rework is dominated by a small number of recurring loops - documentation and information requests, manual spreading corrections, and conditions returned after approval - rather than by isolated one-off errors.

top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Missing or incomplete documentation at submission is corrected later in the process, so the same case is worked more than once.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: The largest rework loop by both case coverage and days lost.

statistics.metric: Average days lost per affected case

top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Financial spreading is performed manually outside the core system, and errors surface at review, requiring the spread to be redone.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: Drives repeated analyst effort on affected cases and contributes directly to first-time-right failure.

top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Approvals granted with conditions are returned for correction because the conditions are not consistently tracked in the system.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: Sends already-approved cases back through credit and approval steps, repeating work already completed.

top_root_causes.root_cause_summary: Collateral records captured as free text are reconciled later, and duplicate guarantor records are resolved manually.
top_root_causes.impact_summary: A smaller loop by volume, but one that consistently produces control exceptions late in the process.

analysis_summary.overall_observation: Across both Critical KPIs the dominant themes are waiting created by sequential approval layers and by information dependencies outside the processing team, and repeated work created by a small number of recurring loops - documentation, manual spreading, and conditions returned after approval. Effort-side issues such as re-keying between systems are present but secondary to waiting and rework.
